title: ingestion embed_query request, v0
description: POST /v0/contributions/ingestion/embed_query, since Plugin API 0.6. Encode one query into one of the plugin's spaces, so a query vector always comes from the model that produced the document vectors.

invocation_id.description: Unique per attempt; correlate logs with it.

modality.description: One of the space's query_modalities. Plugin API 0.6 knows only text.

text.description: The query, trimmed, with line breaks normalized to LF.
